blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Automated report generation can ease the burden radiologists face when interpreting multi-sequence MRI studies. Unlike CT, MRI examinations comprise multiple sequences and imaging planes, each contributing complementary diagnostic information. Existing methods encode a study as a single volume and combine multiple acquisitions by fixed rules. Findings visible in only one plane are thus diluted and often missed, lowering recall on clinical efficacy metrics, where a missed abnormality is most costly. We propose GateSPINE, a vision-language framework that fuses sagittal T1 and T2 volumes with a training-free operator, encodes the fused sagittal and axial volumes with two parallel 3D encoders, and decodes their combined representation into a report. Its core mechanism is a gated cross-view fusion module that predicts, per feature channel and token, how much of each view to admit, so the more informative view dominates at each spatial location. We evaluate GateSPINE on three lumbar MRI datasets, comprising two public benchmarks and a private cohort collected from Phenikaa University Hospital, using both natural language generation (NLG) and clinical efficacy (CE) metrics. GateSPINE achieves the highest CE F1 through improved recall on all three datasets; on SPIDER, which lacks an axial sequence, this reflects the sagittal fusion component rather than the gated cross-view mechanism, which is validated on the two cohorts with both imaging planes. GateSPINE also remains competitive on standard NLG metrics.
blocks.zh: 自动报告生成可以减轻放射学家在解释多序列核磁共振研究时所面临的负担. 与CT不同,核磁共振检查由多序列和成像平面组成,每个都提供互补的诊断信息. 现有方法将一项研究编码为单卷并用固定规则将多项收购结合起来. 仅在一平面上可见的研究结果因此被稀释并经常被忽略,从而降低了临床疗效衡量标准召回率,因为错失的异常最昂贵。 我们提议采用GateSPINE这一视觉语言框架,将T1和T2卷与无训练操作器相接,用两个平行的3D编码器来编码被保险的平面和轴线卷,并将其综合表述解码为一份报告。 其核心机制是一个有入门的交叉视图聚变模块,它预测,每个特性通道和符号,每个视图要承认多少,因此每个空间位置的信息性更强的视角占主导地位. 我们对GateSPINE的3个立体磁共振数据集进行评估,包括两个公共基准和一个从Phenikaa大学医院收集的私人组群,同时使用自然语言生成(NLG)和临床疗效(CE)度量衡。 GateSPINE通过改进所有三个数据集的回放,实现了最高的CE F1;在缺乏轴序的天基信息平台上,这反映了星形聚变组件,而不是有门的交叉视距机制,这种机制在两个成像平面上都经过验证. GateSPINE在标准NLG指标上也保持竞争力.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) is widely used to evaluate degenerative lumbar spine diseases because it provides detailed visualization of soft tissues and neural structures [ 1 , 13 ] . In clinical practice, radiologists must examine multiple MRI sequences (e.g., T1W and T2W) acquired from different imaging planes (e.g., sagittal and axial), integrate the complementary findings across these images, and produce a comprehensive diagnostic report. This process is time-consuming because it requires careful interpretation of a large volume of imaging data, so automatic radiology report generation has attracted increasing attention [ 10 , 11 , 4 ] .
blocks.zh: 磁共振成像(MRI)被广泛用于评价变性的腰椎病,因为它提供了软组织和神经结构的详细可视化[1,13]. 在临床实践中,放射学家必须检查从不同成像平面(如平相和轴相)中获取的多条核磁共振序列(如T1W和T2W),将这些图像的互补结果综合起来,并产生一份全面的诊断报告. 这个过程很花时间,因为它需要仔细地解释一大批成像数据,因此自动放射学报告生成引起了越来越多的关注[10,11,4].

blocks.en:
Automatic report generation from CT typically couples a 3D vision encoder with a language decoder [ 10 ] . Most recently,
Reg2RG [ 7 ] grounds the report on anatomical regions and
combines region-level with global features, substantially improving diagnostic
accuracy. These methods assume that a study is a single volume, whereas an MRI
examination comprises several sequences and imaging planes, each showing some
findings more clearly than the others.
For lumbar spine MRI specifically, SPINE [ 11 ] stacks sagittal
T1- and T2-weighted images together with segmentation labels, showing that
integrating complementary contrasts improves report quality. Yet it models the
sagittal view alone. This omission is consequential because lateral recess
stenosis, facet hypertrophy, and the lateralization of disc herniation are assessed on axial images, findings that a sagittal-only model can therefore characterize only in part. CrossSpine [ 15 ] attends across sequences to predict degeneration grades, but represents each by a single 2D slice. The two views are not interchangeable. Sagittal images trace continuity along the spinal axis and capture disc height, alignment, and marrow signal across all levels at once, whereas axial images expose a per-level geometry that sagittal slices cannot reconstruct. Which view carries the decisive evidence therefore changes from finding to finding, which a fixed combination rule cannot accommodate. To our knowledge, learning to combine sagittal and axial views for lumbar report generation remains unexplored.

blocks.en:
To address this gap, we propose GateSPINE , a unified vision–language framework for lumbar MRI report generation. GateSPINE first
merges sagittal T1 and T2 with a training-free dynamic fusion operator, then encodes the fused sagittal and the axial volumes with two parallel 3D vision encoders. A lightweight gated cross-view fusion module learns, per feature channel, how much of each view to retain, and the resulting representation is decoded into a report by a vision–language model. In summary, our contributions are as follows:

blocks.en: • We propose GateSPINE, a unified vision–language framework that integrates multi-sequence fusion, parallel 3D vision encoders, and adaptive cross-view fusion, improving both clinical-efficacy and language-generation performance. • We design a lightweight gated cross-view fusion module that adaptively combines sagittal and axial representations. The module learns to emphasize the view that provides more informative evidence for each feature channel and spatial position, leading to more effective use of complementary information across MRI sequences and imaging planes. • On the private PhenikaaMec cohort and two public datasets (SPIDER, Lumbar), GateSPINE improves clinical-efficacy micro-F1 over the strongest baseline by 3.6, 3.6, and 26.9 points, driven by recall gains of up to 38.0 points; on SPIDER, which lacks an axial sequence, this reflects the sagittal fusion component rather than the gated cross-view mechanism. GateSPINE also achieves the highest BERTScore on all three datasets (+0.3, +1.3, and +0.4 points).

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: CT report generation.
blocks.zh: CT报告生成.

blocks.en: Most 3D report generation systems extract volume features with a 3D vision encoder and pass them to a language decoder that writes the report. CT2Rep [ 10 ] is an early instance, though its decoder is trained from scratch, which limits fluency. Dia-LLaMA [ 8 ] replaces it with a pretrained LLM and prompts it with predicted disease labels, though it depends on an auxiliary classifier for those labels. Med3DVLM [ 22 ] pursues a different axis, merging low- and high-level features to cut encoding cost, while generalist models treat report generation as one of many tasks [ 21 , 4 ] . Each of these systems therefore combines more than one feature stream. Yet all those streams are extracted from a single volume, so combining them never involves reconciling different views of the anatomy.
blocks.zh: 大多数3D报告生成系统提取带有3D视觉编码器的卷积特性,并传递给写报告的语言解码器. CT2Rep [10]是一个早期的例子,尽管它的解码器是从零开始训练的,这限制了流利性. Dia-LLaMA [8] 取而代之的是预受训练的LLM并用预测的疾病标签来提示它,尽管它依赖于这些标签的辅助分级器. MeD3DVLM [22] 追求不同的轴向,将低等和高等特性合并来削减编码成本,而通论模型则将报告生成视为许多任务之一[21,4]. 因此,每个系统都结合了一个以上的特性流。 然而所有这些溪流都是从一卷取出,所以结合它们从来不涉及调和对解剖学的不同看法.

blocks.en: MRI report generation.
blocks.zh: 核磁共振报告生成。

blocks.en: Report generation for MRI must contend with multiple sequences and imaging planes within one examination. SPINE [ 11 ] stacks sagittal T1 and T2 channel-wise with segmentation-derived channels, showing that combining contrasts improves report quality. Such stacking relies on both sequences being acquired in the same plane, so it does not extend to axial images, whose evidence the model never sees. Other systems take a different route, working from structured gradings [ 17 ] or radiologist-authored findings [ 23 ] rather than from the images themselves. How to combine sagittal and axial evidence therefore remains open. We address this by fusing sequences within a plane and gating across planes at the feature level.
blocks.zh: 核磁共振的报告生成必须在一次检查中与多个序列和成像平面相抗衡。 SPINE [11] 堆放以分块为源的分道道通向分道通航道的分层T1和T2通道,表明结合对比可以提高报告质量. 这种堆放依赖于两个序列在同一平面上被获取,因此它不会被延伸至轴向图像,模型从未看到其证据. 其他系统采用不同的路线,从结构化的分级[17]或放射学家撰写的研究结果[23],而不是从图像本身进行工作. 因此,如何将剖面证据和轴心证据结合起来,仍然没有定论。 我们通过在平面上安装序列 和在平面上进行对接来解决这个问题。

blocks.en: Figure 1: Overview of the GateSPINE framework. Sagittal T1 and T2 volumes are fused by the TTD module, while the axial T2 volume is processed in parallel. Two ViT3D encoders extract features from the fused sagittal volume and the axial volume, and the Gated Cross-View Fusion layer combines them. The 3D Projector then compresses the fused features into visual tokens for the VLM decoder, which generates the final report.

blocks.en: 4 Experiments and Results
blocks.zh: 4 实验和结果

blocks.en: 4.1 Datasets and Evaluation Metrics
blocks.zh: 4.1 数据集和评价计量

blocks.en:
Datasets. PhenikaaMec [ 20 ] is an internal cohort of 250 patients (112/138
M/F, aged 48.1 ± 15.2 48.1\pm 15.2 years) with sagittal T1, sagittal T2, and axial T2 at 0.3 × 0.3 × 4.4 0.3\times 0.3\times 4.4 mm, extracted from hospital PACS and anonymized under appropriate ethical clearance; 236 remain after discarding cases lacking a report or axial sequence. The reports are translated from Vietnamese with LLaMA-3.3-70B, and we split by acquisition month into 118/58/60 studies training on earlier months and testing on later ones to mirror deployment. Lumbar [ 2 ] contains 575 Mendeley cases (one per patient) with both planes; 515 remain after discarding empty reports, split 70:15:15. SPIDER [ 19 ] provides sagittal T1, T2, and segmentation masks but no axial sequence and no free-text reports, split 60:20:20 by patient. On SPIDER, all methods use the reference reports released by SPINE [ 11 ] , generated from grading labels with GPT-4. Without an axial sequence the cross-view module is inactive, and, following SPINE, the mask is combined with T1 and T2 per slice in ratio : : 3 2\!:\!2\!:\!3 in place of TTD; SPIDER thus tests the sagittal branch, while the gated cross-view module is evaluated on the two cohorts with both planes.
blocks.zh:
数据集. PhenikaaMec [20] 是250名患者的内部群体(112/138)
M/F,年龄48.1±15.2 48.1\pm 15.2岁),有平面图T1,平面图T2和轴T2为0.3×0.3× 4.3\tims 4.4毫米,取自医院的PACS并经过适当的道德审查后匿名;有236个在丢弃缺乏报告或轴序的病例后仍保留. 这些报告由越南语译作LLaMA-3.3-70B,我们按采购月分成118/58/60关于前几个月的学习培训和对后几个月的测试,以反映部署情况。 朗巴 [2] 包含 575起门德利病例(每名病人1起),两架飞机都有;515起在丢弃空报后仍保留,分出70:15. SPIDER [19] 提供平面T1,T2和分块口罩但无轴序和自由文字报告,由患者分出60:20:20. 在天基信息平台上,所有方法都使用SPINE[11]发布的参考报告,这些参考报告来自GPT-4的分级标签。 没有轴序,交叉视图模块不活动,在SPINE之后,口罩由T1和T2结合成每片比例: : 3 2\!:\ ! 2\:\ 3 取代 TTD; 天基信息平台因此测试了平面分枝, 而有门的交叉视图模块则在两架飞机的两组上进行评估 。

blocks.en: Evaluation Metrics. Following recent report generation work [ 11 , 7 ] , we report language quality (NLP) and clinical efficacy (CE) metrics. The NLP metrics are BLEU-4 [ 16 ] , ROUGE-1, ROUGE-L [ 14 ] , METEOR [ 5 ] , and BERTScore [ 24 ] . These cannot capture diagnostic correctness, since a negation flips meaning while leaving surface similarity intact. CE metrics therefore compare clinical entities: an LLM judge (LLaMA-3.3-70B) labels nine lumbar findings—disc herniation, bulge, degeneration, spinal stenosis, osteophytes, nerve compression, curvature abnormality, annular tear, and disc height loss—as present or absent in both generated and reference reports. We report Micro-F1 pooled over findings and Macro-F1 averaged over them. The same judge scores every method, so the comparison is consistent across models; validating the judge and the report translation against radiologist annotation is left to future work.
blocks.zh: 评价计量。 继最近的报告生成工作[11,7]之后,我们报告语言质量(NLP)和临床疗效(CE)指标。 NLP的度量衡是:BLEU-4 [16],ROUGE-1,ROUGE-L [14],METEOR [5],和BERTSCore [24]. 这些不能捕捉诊断正确性,因为否定性在使表面相似性保持不变的同时会产生意义翻转。 因此,CE指标比较了临床实体:一个LLM法官(LLAMA-3.3-70B)标出9个立方体的发现,即所生成的和参考报告都存在或没有的有:异形隐形、膨胀、退化、脊柱性收缩、骨质萎缩、神经收缩、曲率异常、废损和盘高损失。 我们报告说,微F1集成了调查结果,而Macro-F1集成了调查结果。 同一法官对每一种方法都进行评分,因此不同模型的比较是一致的;对照放射学家的注释验证法官与报告翻译,则留待未来工作.

blocks.en: 4.2 Implementation Details and Baselines
blocks.zh: 4.2 执行细节和基线

blocks.en: Implementation. GateSPINE is implemented in PyTorch and trained on one NVIDIA Quadro RTX 8000, with MedGemma 4B-IT as decoder and both ViT3D encoders initialized from M3D [ 4 ] . Volumes are resampled to D t × H t × W t = 32 × 256 × 256 D_{t}\times H_{t}\times W_{t}=32\times 256\times 256 and split into ( 4 , 16 , 16 ) (4,16,16) patches ( N = 2048 N=2048 , d = 768 d=768 ); pooling with ρ = 2 \rho=2 gives N v = 256 N_{v}=256 visual tokens, projected via d m = 1152 d_{m}=1152 to d LLM = 2560 d_{\text{LLM}}=2560 , and TTD uses γ = 50 \gamma=50 . Stage 1 trains the encoders, gate, and adapter with the LLM frozen (learning rate 10 − 4 10^{-4} ); stage 2 adds LoRA [ 12 ] (rank 8, scaling 32, dropout 0.05) and fine-tunes jointly with a per-dataset learning rate. Both stages use AdamW with cosine decay, mixed precision, an effective batch size of 8 via gradient accumulation, and 10–15 epochs with early stopping.

blocks.en: Baselines. We compare against CT2Rep [ 10 ] , Med3DVLM [ 22 ] , Dia-LLaMA [ 8 ] , and SPINE [ 11 ] , retrained on each dataset with the same preprocessed inputs and greedy decoding. Being single-volume methods, they receive the fused sagittal volume without the axial branch, so this comparison reflects the framework as a whole; the ablation in Sec. 4.4 , where every variant receives both planes, isolates the fusion mechanism.
blocks.zh: 基线。 我们比较了 CT2Rep [10], MeD3DVLM [22], Dia-LLAMA [8], 以及 SPINE [11] , 用相同的预处理输入和贪婪的解码对每个数据集进行再培训. 作为单体积方法,它们接收到没有轴子分支的被熔化的相片体积,因此这种比较反映了整个框架;Sec 4.4中的衰竭,每个变体都接收到两平面,从而隔离了聚变机制.

blocks.en: 4.3 Evaluation Results
blocks.zh: 4.3 评价结果

blocks.en: Table 1: Comparison with state-of-the-art methods on language-quality (NLP) and clinical-efficacy (CE) metrics across three datasets. Best and second-best results in bold and underlined .
blocks.zh: 表1:与三个数据集的语言质量(NLP)和临床效率(CE)衡量标准的最新方法的比较。 以粗体和下划线显示最佳和次佳成果。

blocks.en: On PhenikaaMec, GateSPINE achieves the best clinical entity scores and leads on ROUGE and BERTScore (Table 1 ). Its clinical gain comes mainly from higher recall (Micro-R 67.35 vs. 52.05 for Dia-LLaMA) at comparable precision, so it misses fewer true findings. Dia-LLaMA scores higher on BLEU-4 and METEOR but is much weaker on clinical entities. Across the nine findings (Fig. 2 ), GateSPINE leads on seven of nine, with the clearest margins over SPINE on disc degeneration and osteophytes; it trails only on disc bulge, a naming bias rather than a miss: of 29 reference bulges it calls 24 a herniation and omits only 4. Since bulge and herniation are separate labels on a clinical continuum, this lowers Macro-F1 more than Micro-F1. On SPIDER, GateSPINE leads on all NLG metrics and on both F1 scores, with the largest margin on Macro-F1 ( + 7.2 +7.2 ). Med3DVLM attains higher precision but far lower recall, describing fewer findings overall. Because the references here are GPT-4-generated from grading labels rather than written by radiologists, they are highly templated; absolute scores on SPIDER are inflated relative to the other two datasets and should be read only within this benchmark. On the public Lumbar dataset, GateSPINE is again best on both metric groups, above CT2Rep and SPINE. Macro-F1 stays low because every model scores zero on osteophytes and disc height loss, and the short segmentation-style references make both metric groups harder to satisfy.
blocks.zh: 在PhenikaaMec上,GateSPINE取得了最佳临床实体分数并领先于ROUGE和BERTScore(表1). 其临床增益主要出自高回想(Micro-R 67.35 vs 52.05 for Dia-LLaMA),具有可比较的精确性,因此它忽略了较少的真实发现. 迪亚-LLa BLEU-4和METEOR的MA分数较高,但临床实体的分数更低。 在9个发现(图2)中,GateSPINE领先于9个中的7个,比SPINE在盘状变质和卵生化上的边缘最清晰;它只在盘状出轨,是一种取名偏差,而不是漏出:29个参考出入境点中,它称24个为隐士,只省略了4个. 由于膨胀和分泌在临床连续体上是单独的标签,这比Micro-F1要低. 在天基信息平台上,GateSPINE领先于所有NLG度量衡和两个F1分数,在Macro-F1(+7.2+7.2)上比分最大. MeD3DVLM的精确度较高,但回溯率更低,说明总体调查结果较少。 由于此处的参考文献是GPT-4从分级标签生成的,而不是由放射学家撰写的,因此它们具有很高的模板;相对于其他两个数据集,天基信息平台的绝对分数被夸大,只应在这一基准范围内阅读。 在公共的Lumbar数据集上,GateSPINE再次在CT2Rep和SPINE以上的两个公制组上表现得最好. macro-F1保持低调,因为每个模型在骨骼和盘高损失上都得分为零,而短分化风格的参考使得两个公制组都更难被满足.

blocks.en: Figure 2: F1 score for each clinical finding on PhenikaaMec.
blocks.zh: 图2: PhenikaaMec上每次临床发现的F1分.

blocks.en: 4.4 Ablation Studies and Analyses
blocks.zh: 4.4 研究与分析

blocks.en: Contribution of MRI Sequences. We assess each sequence by turning sequences on and off on PhenikaaMec and Lumbar, as shown in Table 2 . A single sequence is not enough on either dataset. On PhenikaaMec, sagittal T2 is the best single view, since most degenerative findings are clearer on T2-weighted images, and sagittal T1 is the weakest. On Lumbar the order flips: axial T2 is strongest, matching a stenosis-focused cohort where the axial plane best shows canal narrowing. Adding the axial view on top of the fused sagittal T1 and T2 gives a large jump in clinical entity scores on both datasets. The full three-sequence setup is best on every metric, and the gated integration of the axial plane drives most of the clinical entity gain.
blocks.zh: 磁共振序列的贡献。 如表2所示,我们通过打开和关闭PhenikaaMec和Lumbar上的序列来评估每个序列。 在两个数据集中,一个序列是不够的。 在PhenikaaMec上, sagital T2是最佳的单景,因为大多数变质发现在T2加权图像上更为清晰,而 sagital T1则是最弱. 在Lumbar上,订单翻转:轴式T2最强,匹配一个以快感为重点的组群,轴式平面最能显示运河收缩. 将轴景加到被熔化的平面图T1和T2上,使临床实体在两个数据集上的分数有了较大的跳跃. 完整的三序设置在每个度量衡上都是最好的,轴平面的入门融合驱动了大部分临床实体增益.

blocks.en: Table 2: Ablation on input MRI sequences. Best in bold , second best underlined .
blocks.zh: 表2:输入磁共振序列的偏差。 最好用粗体标出,

blocks.en: Cross-View Fusion Mechanism. Table 3 compares three cross-view fusion methods. We first expected the uncertainty-aware dynamic fusion to perform best, but the simple gated fusion outperforms both concatenation and dynamic fusion. This holds on both PhenikaaMec and Lumbar. We attribute this to the gate acting as a stable, content-dependent selector that is easier to train on small medical data than a larger dynamic weighting module.
blocks.zh: 跨视融合机制. 表3比较了三种交叉视图聚变方法. 我们最初预计,认识到不确定性的动态核聚变效果最好,但简单的入门核聚变效果既超过了凝聚效果,也超过了动态核聚变效果. 这对PhenikaaMec和Lumbar来说都很重要。 我们将此归因于大门作为稳定、依赖内容的选择器,它比更大的动态加权模块更容易在小型医学数据上训练。

blocks.en: Table 3: Ablation on the cross-view fusion mechanism (rows 1–3, MedGemma decoder) and on the language decoder (rows 3–4, gate fusion; MedGemma 4B vs. Phi-3-mini 3.8B). Best in bold , second best underlined among fusion variants.
blocks.zh: 表3:交叉视聚变机制(第1至3行,MedGemma解码器)和语言解码器(第3至4行,出门聚变;MedGemma 4B vs. Phi-3-mini 3.8B). 以粗体表示最好, 在聚变体中划得第二好。

blocks.en: LLM as the Language Decoder. To isolate the decoder’s role, we keep the 3D visual architecture, gated fusion, and projector fixed and swap only the LLM decoder, as shown in Table 3 . MedGemma outperforms Phi-3 on every metric. The gap is small on language metrics but much larger on clinical efficacy. We attribute this to MedGemma’s biomedical pre-training, which turns the same features into more accurate findings.
blocks.zh: LLM作为语言解码器. 为了隔离解码器的作用,我们保留了3D视觉架构,门式聚变,和投影仪固定并只交换LLM解码器,如表3所示。 MedGemma 超效率 每个度量的Phi -3 语言计量方面的差距很小,但临床疗效的差距更大。 我们将此归因于MedGemma的生物医学前训练,它把同样的特征转化为更准确的发现.

blocks.en: Analysis of Generated Reports. Figure 3 shows one representative case from each dataset, comparing generated and ground-truth reports and judged on abnormality type, location, and severity. Across all three datasets, GateSPINE recovers most major abnormalities with fewer hallucinated and missed findings than SPINE, which both misses findings and adds irrelevant text. The remaining GateSPINE errors are concentrated in the vertebral level and in lesion severity, which we target in future work.
blocks.zh: 分析产生的报告。 图3显示每个数据集中有一个具有代表性的案例,比较生成的和地面真实的报告,并根据异常类型、地点和严重程度进行判断。 在所有三个数据集中,GateSPINE以比SPINE更少的幻觉和错失的发现恢复了大多数主要的异常,这些发现既错过了发现,又添加了无关的文本. 其余的GateSPINE出错主要集中在脊椎上和损伤严重性上,我们在今后的工作中都瞄准了这些.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusions
blocks.zh: 5. 结论

blocks.en: In this paper, we propose GateSPINE , a unified vision–language framework for lumbar spine MRI report generation. Unlike existing methods that do not fully utilize the complementary information from different MRI views, GateSPINE introduces a lightweight gated cross-view fusion module to adaptively combine sagittal and axial representations. The proposed module learns how much information to preserve from each view for every feature channel, enabling the model to better exploit complementary information across MRI sequences and imaging planes. On one private and two public lumbar MRI datasets, GateSPINE achieves the best performance on clinical-efficacy metrics while remaining competitive on language-generation metrics. Furthermore, ablation studies show that the gated cross-view fusion module outperforms existing fusion strategies.
blocks.zh: 在本文中,我们提出GateSPINE, 一个统一的视觉-语言框架,用于制作腰椎核磁共振报告。 与没有充分利用来自不同核磁共振观点的补充信息的现有方法不同,GateSPINE引入了轻量级的入门交叉视图聚变模块来适应性地将平面和轴表示相融合. 拟议的模块了解每个功能通道可从每个视图中保存多少信息,使模型能够更好地利用磁共振序列和成像平面的补充信息。 GateSPINE在一个私人和两个公共立体核磁共振数据集上,在临床效果度量衡上取得了最佳成绩,同时在语言生成度量上仍然具有竞争力。 此外,停产研究显示,入门的交叉视聚变模块超过了现有的聚变战略。

blocks.en: One limitation of the current framework is that it mainly relies on global image representations, which can cause the model to occasionally miss subtle lesions or describe their anatomical locations inaccurately, as illustrated in Fig. 3 . In future work, we plan to incorporate finer-grained anatomical information, such as disc-level segmentation or lesion detection, to improve localization accuracy and further enhance report quality.
blocks.zh: 目前框架的一个局限性是,它主要依靠全球图像表示,这可能会使模型偶尔错过微妙的损伤,或者不准确地描述其解剖位置,如图3所示。 在今后的工作中,我们计划纳入更精细的解剖信息,如盘平分或损伤检测,以提高本地化准确性并进一步提高报告质量.
